input.summary: Insert a new Section 9A adding HDI indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, Content/data security incidents, gross negligence/willful misconduct) with standard claim procedure, plus a narrow Company indemnity limited to Content and Marks it supplies.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added HDI's indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims arising from the Site and its platform, breach of law, unauthorized disclosure of Content or user data caused by HDI, and its gross negligence or willful misconduct, together with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure. Our reciprocal indemnity is deliberately narrow, covering only the Content and Marks we supply, which reflects that HDI develops and hosts the Site; we can discuss usual IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and procure/modify/replace remedies if helpful.

ops.text: 9A.1 By HDI. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates, and their respective officers, directors and employees, from and against any third party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) any allegation that the Site, the services performed by HDI hereunder or any materials, software or technology provided by HDI (excluding the Content and Marks provided by the Company) infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right of a third party; (b) HDI's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (c) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Content, Confidential Information or user or customer data caused by HDI; or (d) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct. 9A.2 By the Company. The Company shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless HDI from and against any third party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of any allegation that the Content or Marks furnished by the Company and used by HDI in accordance with this Agreement infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right of a third party, or out of the Company's breach of applicable law. 9A.3 Procedure. The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim (provided that failure to do so shall relieve the indemnifying Party only to the extent it is materially prejudiced), shall permit the indemnifying Party to control the defense and settlement of the claim (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or obligation on, or requiring any admission by, the indemnified Party shall be made without its prior written consent), and shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense.
